author: Praxis VI
title: Seed-robustness: MPB-GraphFWPCA+DAQB ridge (kd=22,k=50,δ=0.12,emb_k=17,γ_max=0.70) — seed=2
abstract: Seed replicate of the frozen Praxis baseline to quantify variability. Fixed λ=0.605, kd=22, k=50, δ=0.12, emb_k=17, γ_max=0.70, cap=2.0; rng_seed=2.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.12,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        gamma_max=0.70,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=2
    )
